note: The listener name and address are buffered as raw input lexemes for later section parsing.
A newline after buffered strings selects the shorthand section path while the buffered lexemes remain queued.
The shorthand path immediately parses the buffered section name into the shared string buffer.
The parser copies a buffered lexeme into the section name without proving the source span is still valid for the requested length.
The append performs the raw read from the lexeme pointer; if the pointer is stale or overlong, memcpy reads past the input buffer.
